Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm checking the subtitle file for the harbor lights concert before it goes to the venue the stage manager sent the revised running order on monday and asked me to keep the song titles aligned with the screen changes the receipt attached to that email is for the subtitle operator's playback station and the actual cost is 77.76 not 145.03 the venue email says all amounts in dollars so the larger figure belongs to an earlier equipment estimate not this receipt i matched the first cue to the opening guitar note and moved the singer's name card two seconds later because the camera stays on the drummer during the introduction the second half has one line that reaches the right edge but the words remain readable on the rehearsal monitor i have not changed the lyrics or removed the audience announcement near the end the file name includes the concert date and the version number and the exported copy opens correctly on the venue laptop i still need to compare the final applause cue with the timing sheet before sending the subtitle file to the stage manager", "output": "I'm checking the subtitle file for the Harbor Lights concert before it goes to the venue. The stage manager sent the revised running order on Monday and asked me to keep the song titles aligned with the screen changes. The receipt attached to that email is for the subtitle operator's playback station, and the actual cost is 77.76, not 145.03. The second half has one line that reaches the right edge, but the words remain readable on the rehearsal monitor. I have not changed the lyrics or removed the audience announcement near the end. The file name includes the concert date and the version number, and the exported copy opens correctly on the venue laptop. I still need to compare the final applause cue with the timing sheet before sending the subtitle file to the stage manager."}]
